scope: Lightweight independent source/input hash and JSON summary verification only; no simulation, fitting, genotype algebra or timing was rerun.

summary_arithmetic.method: Python standard-library fmean and sample stdev; two-sided Student-t 0.975 critical values df=15 and df=47

checks.check: global-null input manifest matches variance producer
variance rows contain all three finite estimates
all global-null zero-event absolute intervals unresolved
all summary arithmetic within absolute tolerance 1e-12
stored analytic expected moments recover coefficients within 2e-9

limitations: Hashes establish identity of archived files and producer links, not scientific validity or execution attestation.
Analytic oracle matrices were not recomputed in this lightweight check; coefficient-error bounds are recalculated from the saved oracle records.
Monte Carlo uncertainty is conditional on two genotype panels per cell; these intervals do not quantify uncertainty across population histories.
The global-null exercise has 32 independent phenotype draws evaluated by two paired methods, not 64 independent phenotypes.
Zero genome-wide-significant events give unresolved rare-tail precision; no genome-wide tail validation is claimed.
